Abebook.description: First paperback edition (1994) of Rush Rehm's study of Greek tragedy in performance, published in Routledge's Theatre Production Studies series under general editor John Russell Brown; first published in hardback in 1992. Trade paperback in cream pictorial wrappers with a black spine, issued without dust jacket. Corners lightly bumped and the wrapper edges show slight handling wear; the spine is uncreased and unbroken, the binding tight and square. Text clean and unmarked throughout, with no previous owner's marks. A near fine copy.
